title: static-shard config
description: static-shard.config.json — written by `static-shard-cli init`, consumed by `static-shard-cli build`.

$schema.description: Editor autocomplete/validation reference to this file.

formatVersion.description: The static-shard-cli major version this config's baked schema was inferred against.

collection.description: Name the generated collection is exposed under, e.g. `db.movies`.

path.description: A single file path, or a glob pattern matching same-format files to merge then shard as one dataset.

delimiter.description: Delimited (csv/tsv) column delimiter override. Default: "," for csv, "\t" for tsv.

records.description: JSON only: dot-path to the array/map of records nested within the parsed document.

basePath.description: Baked default for the generated `connect()`. Default "/shard-data".

shardBytes.description: Target compressed shard size in bytes. Default 2 MiB.

indexChunkBytes.description: Target gzipped size per secondary-index chunk, in bytes. Default ~45 KB.

schema.description: The machine-owned baked schema block (written/refreshed by `init`/`init --reinfer`).

sortField.description: Must name a "number", "date" or "string" field — the sole range-partitioned field. This choice decides which records are stored next to each other, so it is the single biggest lever on query cost: filters on this field read a few data files, filters on anything else may read most of them.

pk.description: Names a field as the user PK — unlocks the generated client's `get(id)`.

kind.description: "json" is payload-only: carried in each record but never indexed or queryable.

indexed.description: Opt-in secondary index: builds a chunked inverted index + zonemap for this non-sort field.

endsWith.description: Opt-in reversed-value index — unlocks `endsWith`. Requires kind "string" and indexed: true.

contains.description: Opt-in trigram index — unlocks `contains`. Requires kind "string" and indexed: true.

absent.description: Value may be missing from a record (absent ≠ null) — unlocks isNull/isAbsent/exists. Requires indexed: true.

multi.description: Scalar leaf under an object-array — record value is string[], matched existentially via `some`. Requires kind "string" and indexed: true.

values.description: The field's closed value set. Codegen exports it as a named union and narrows equals/in/some to it (fragment operators startsWith/contains/endsWith stay wide). Inferred for enum-like fields; delete it to widen the field back to plain string. Requires kind "string" and indexed: true.
